fixed_setup.hand_policy: These are forced scripted cards, NOT naturally drawn; all three are removed from the full 99-card library for each matched variant before sampling cascade.
actions_turn6: Cast Boltwave from hand and fully resolve stack (sets threshold from actual damage)
Cast the relevant one-for-one slot spell from hand with legal creature target for Bituminous Blast
Resolve cascade triggers, supported hit effects, and main spell
actions_turn7: Advance turn, clear threshold and floating mana
If added Heartless/Tree survived, activate legal tap ability
Cast held Flame Rift from hand, resolve resulting triggers/cascade

pairing: Use grixis_paired.align to align canonical 99 and swap 99; use grixis_sim.seed_for(seed,i) and identical 99-index shuffle. Each scenario removes the same two held spells and its own one swapped slot; the remaining 96-card libraries must retain paired shared order.
cascade_policy: Use locked Scryfall card metadata for every card in remaining 96, reveal through lands and higher-mv cards, and record first nonland lower-MV hit. Supported Cycle-96 effects may be cast for free from cascade. Unsupported effects are NEVER fabricated: log uncensored hit name and 'declined_unmodeled' and put all revealed cards on randomized bottom. This is a specified conservative policy, not how a rational player necessarily plays.
outputs: baseline-permutation trace equality across both swaps
all-scenario scripted cast, grant and printed cascade event counts
distribution of real deck-identity hits for supported and unsupported cards
coverage fraction of offered cascade hits whose full effects are represented
complete source, simulator, prereg and prior-cycle hashes
first representative trace events for audit
explicit_limitations: This is an effect-aware bounded scripted comparison over seeded complete source libraries, NOT full-deck goldfish, realistic opening hands, mulligan/gameplay sampling, matchup simulation, or win rates.
Forced turn-six commander, forced in-hand three-card sequence and injected mana assume setup that may not occur in games; no probabilities of drawing, mana readiness or survival.
Unmodeled cascade hits are conservatively declined even if normally useful; downstream conditional damage, costs and win probability cannot be compared across variants.
No real priority/opponent policy distributions, graveyard recursion, tutors, draw-selection, combat, threats, actual opponent-target state, or extra effects beyond Cycle-96 supported cards.
No statistical significance test or proposed upgrade decision from deterministic scripted branch frequency: only coverage and distribution under the preregistered replay policy.
Missing coverage is a blocking gate, not zero improvement; M6 cannot be accepted until complete evidence, judgments, I/J certificates and user approval.
